title: Architecture Course on Bazel
description: Get the architecture course (@teaching/architecture-course and its dependency closure: proctor, course product, pets, assets, tokens) running and building efficiently over Bazel (`bun repo --tool=bazel run ...`) as part of the new build system: every course target (build, test, typecheck, check, dev, dev-site, publish, test-e2e) executes through the Bazel backend on macOS, Linux and Windows; warm rebuilds are cache hits; selected edits invalidate only affected actions; progress and cancellation work. Related: tickets 26/10/14/ABSTRACT-REPO-BUILD-TOOLS-AND-ADD-BAZEL, 26/10/18/GET-CODEBASE-RUNNING-END-TO-END-AGAIN (wave 1020b Bazel executors) and 26/10/02/TEACHING-ARCHITECTURE-DEPLOY-READY. Fleet: Opus 5.5 coordinator, Sonnet 5.5 High executors, Haiku 5.5 High auditors.
